about: The DigiDestined and other Digimon Tamers as special trainers (designed by the user): who they are, their sprite, the Pokémon (species) that always leads their team, and in Multi Battles who partners them. Teams are in digidestined.txt. 'weight': their weight in the special-trainer pool (the Gym Leaders are 7). 'partners': in a Multi Battle they always battle alongside one of these (picked with equal chance), who goes first (shown on the left); a partner can be a Battle Legend (Tai) or another trainer listed here. After editing either file, run: npm run data:custom
